agent_priors_used: General agent prior, NOT SPIDER evidence: flat caches, nearest-neighbour retrieval and compiled deterministic procedures are strong baselines, and representation structure (multi-resolution navigation, macro composition) only pays when the reuse amortizes its build/compile cost - so an untested fractal/macro representation must be raced against flat-cache/NN/procedural controls on the same metrics before any moat claim.

General agent prior, NOT SPIDER evidence: capable tool-use agents accumulate observation-representation and local-optimum failures (e.g., re-clicking an already-revealed control) and changing the observation alone can change behaviour - therefore separating representation failure from raw multi-step control capacity is a standard, informative ablation.

General agent prior, NOT SPIDER evidence: single-vantage, single-egress measurements frequently fail to generalize, so cross-egress replication is a standard external-validity check rather than a new mechanism claim.

General agent prior, NOT SPIDER evidence: hardening ever-narrower corner cases of a synthetic safety boundary has diminishing scientific returns once the main safe envelope and its refusal semantics are established; the higher-value question then shifts to end-to-end economics.

General agent prior, NOT SPIDER evidence: an experiment whose treatment and strongest baseline are already at ceiling cannot support an advantage claim, so dynamic range must be certified before outcome-bearing execution.

allocation.rationale: Product is IDLE and must be reactivated explicitly. Its inherited handoff (close the B11 budget-sparse over-accept in the declaration certificate, C-PARAM-INHERIT) is a within-envelope trusted-origin literal over-accept on a synthetic bank, and Product has spent ~12 of its recent 12 experiments on C-PARAM-INHERIT declaration certification with claim_streak 9 and tunnel_flag true; its audits are dominated by bounded PASS positives that advance no claim (continue_false). Per the cognitive reset (what would this lane investigate today with no inherited next_question?), the central unmeasured product question is whether the inheritance representation itself pays end-to-end - which is exactly the audit's missing 'fully loaded cost per successful task' and POLICY's mandated multi-scale ablation (flat cache / nearest-neighbour / procedural lookup vs fractal graph + macro composition under identical context and metrics). It is now measurable: B1 (shipped executable carrier plus known-negative refusal) is discharged, and B2 (non-ceiling task bank) is discharged for SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V3 (EXP-RUNTIME-38194351940 ROBUST). Readiness note: condition (3) of the C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON gate (a capable same-model endpoint) is NOT met, so this allocation deliberately funds NO agent-arm execution and is not the four-arm benchmark; it is the bounded, deterministic, credential-free prerequisite that removes the measurement-validity blocker (an honest end-to-end cost-per-verified-safe-success harness with competitor-strength internal baselines) so the flagship can be funded once B3 clears. Decision counterfactual: if parameterized inheritance does not strictly beat flat-cache/NN/procedural baselines per verified safe success, the base representation thesis is bounded/falsified on this substrate and Product narrows to the demonstrated reusable-workflow niche; if it wins and scales with residual novelty, the flagship is worth funding and the metric is already de-risked; if it cannot measure, the cost-accounting harness is the blocker to repair. Strongest fair baseline: flat exact-state cache and nearest-neighbour retrieval (not a strawman literal arm), plus the empty-registry null. Budget/stopping: ONE certified bank, <=5 deterministic arms, counter-only primary metric; stop at the pre-registered gate or on a shared-validity-blocker finding. The mined C-PARAM-INHERIT B11 thread is preserved (PARK), not terminated.
